instruction.text: Jeremy pushed his toy car towards a ramp. This distance-time graph shows how many centimetres the toy car travelled over 10 seconds.

atoms.a: How far did the toy car travel in 5 seconds?
After how many seconds had the car travelled 20 centimetres?
How many centimetres did the toy car travel between 3 and 7 seconds?
After how many seconds did the car stop moving?
How far did the car travel in 2 seconds?
How far did the car travel in 10 seconds?

instruction.text: Decide if the following statements about the distance-time graph are true.

atoms.a: You could use this distance-time graph to see how fast the toy car was going during the 10 seconds.
This distance-time graph shows that the car kept going faster with each passing second.
This distance-time graph shows what track the toy car was travelling on.
